subtitle: Your files. Your devices.
intro: A private way to move files between the devices around you.
emptyPeersHelp: Open Receive on the other device. Connect both devices to the same network or use a temporary hotspot.
pairingLink: Pairing link from the receiving device
privacyBadge: Encrypted • No account • No cloud upload
sendHint: Choose what you want to share, then pick a device.
dropHint: Or choose files from your device. Up to 128 files per transfer.
receiveHint: Keep this screen open. The sender can scan your QR code or paste your pairing link.
noAddress: No local network address. Connect to Wi-Fi or a hotspot, then refresh.
compareCode: Compare all four groups on both devices. Accept only if every group matches.
trustedNotice: Remembered devices still require approval for every transfer.
historyHint: History stays on this device. Clearing it does not delete received files.
storageHint: Files arrive in the private app folder, in a separate folder for each transfer. Names are prefixed with a number to avoid collisions.
resumeHint: Retry keeps verified completed files. An interrupted file restarts from the beginning. Keep the app open and keep your source files unchanged.
privacyText: No account, server, analytics, or cloud storage is used. Discovery broadcasts your device name and public certificate fingerprint on the local network while receiving. History contains file names and transfer metadata on this device. Private keys use the operating system secure store.
lanHelp: On the receiver, open Receive. Join the same Wi-Fi, Ethernet LAN, or hotspot. Scan again on the sender. If discovery is blocked, copy or scan the receiver’s pairing link. Internet is not required. A QR code cannot create a network connection.
hotspotHelp: Create a hotspot in the operating system settings on a supported device. Join it manually from the other device, then open Receive and refresh addresses. Some systems require mobile data to enable Personal Hotspot; FlowShare does not use an internet relay.
androidHotspotHelp: Create a local-only Android hotspot below. Join the displayed network from the other device using its password. Then start receiving and refresh addresses. This hotspot does not provide internet access.
permissionsHelp: Allow local network access for discovery. Camera access is requested only when scanning. Android hotspot creation requests Nearby Wi-Fi Devices (or location on older Android). Selected files use the system picker; unrestricted storage access is not requested.
firewallHelp: On Windows, allow FlowShare on your private network when prompted. Guest Wi-Fi and client isolation may block peers. Try a trusted hotspot. Do not disable your firewall.
backgroundHelp: Keep iPhone/iPad awake and FlowShare visible during transfers; iOS can suspend local sockets. Android uses a visible transfer service. Desktop transfers can continue while minimized, but closing the app, sleeping, or changing networks may interrupt them.
directUnavailable: Nearby Connections, Wi-Fi Aware, Wi-Fi Direct, and Apple peer-to-peer adapters are not included in this preview. Use a local network or a guided hotspot connection.
remoteUnavailable: Internet sharing is not implemented. FlowShare never switches to a cloud relay.
onboard1Text: Send photos, videos, documents, and more with one familiar experience.
onboard2Text: Use an available local network, or follow the hotspot guide when you have no shared Wi-Fi.
onboard3Text: Verify the connection on both devices. Every incoming transfer needs your approval.
permissionDenied: Permission denied. Enable the requested permission in system settings and try again.
authenticationFailed: Device identity could not be verified. Refresh the receiver’s pairing link and compare all code groups.
rejected: The transfer was declined. Ask the other person before trying again.
connectionLost: Connection lost. Reconnect to the network and retry.
connectionTimeout: Connection timed out. Check Wi-Fi, local-network permission, and firewall settings.
insufficientStorage: Not enough storage. Free space and retry.
fileChanged: A source file changed. Select it again to start a new transfer.
fileUnavailable: A file is no longer accessible. Select it again or check storage access.
checksumMismatch: File verification failed. The incomplete file was not committed. Retry the transfer.
unsafeFilename: A filename is not safe on all platforms. Rename it and try again.
unsafeDestination: The destination is not safe. Clear incomplete fragments or start a new transfer.
resumeMismatch: Saved recovery data does not match. Start a new transfer.
protocolVersion: The devices use incompatible protocol versions. Update both apps.
invalidMetadata: Invalid file metadata. Choose fewer files or rename unsupported filenames.
invalidFrame: Unexpected transfer data. Check that both devices use the same app version, then retry.
invalidInvitation: Invalid pairing link. Copy the complete link from Receive on the other device.
operationFailed: The operation could not finish. Check system permissions and try again.
hotspotUnavailable: The hotspot could not start. Check Wi-Fi and location settings, or use a shared network.
foregroundUnavailable: The Android transfer notification could not start. Keep the app visible and check notification permissions.
initializationFailed: FlowShare could not open secure storage or its local database. Restart the app; do not clear app data unless you have backed up received files.
